item.title: Victoria Starmer models clothes at London fashion week show
item.description: Wife of former PM takes part in designer Edeline Lee’s show inspired by the Greek myth of Sisyphus Victoria Starmer has taken part in a London fashion week show, in one of her first public appearances since her husband, Keir Starmer, stepped down as prime minister. Lady Starmer appeared at Sunday’s Edeline Lee show. The London-based, Canadian British designer’s clothes are a favourite of the Princess of Wales, and have also been worn by celebrities including singer Taylor Swift and actor and screenwriter Phoebe Waller-Bridge. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia in "largest ever" attack on Moscow
item.description: Russia is completing its three-day vote for the Duma this Sunday – the first since its large-scale invasion of Ukraine. The election was organised for the first time also in the Ukrainian regions occupied by Russia, and it was marked by Ukrainian drone strikes at various areas - mainly Moscow. Details by Shirli Sitbon. Publicado también por: The Times of India - World, NPR - World, ABC News Australia. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: En directo: Israel ordena bloqueos y "extensas" redadas en Cisjordania tras un mortal tiroteo
item.description: Luego de que un atacante palestino matara a un colono israelí cerca del asentamiento de Neve Tzuf, el primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu instó al Ejército a cerrar poblados del centro de Cisjordania ocupada y preparar incursiones para detener a palestinos. Además, en otro incidente, soldados israelíes mataron a un conductor palestino, al que acusaron de un supuesto intento de atropellamiento. Mientras tanto, las tensiones siguen altas en Medio Oriente por nuevas amenazas de Irán y los ataques de los hutíes contra Arabia Saudita. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Italy to limit foreign students, ban burqa and hijab in schools
item.description: In a bold move, Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni unveiled new regulations for schools, prohibiting face coverings such as burqas and niqabs in classrooms. The initiative also sets a limit on foreign students per class and requires parents of foreign students to learn Italian, promoting integration and ensuring that Italian children feel at home, rather than a minority in their own schools. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: US, China seek Xi-Trump summit deliverables in New York talks
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer held their final preparatory talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York on Sunday to work out deliverables for next week’s summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump in Washington. The leaders are meeting at JP Morgan’s headquarters in the city to discuss possible economic outcomes for the summit and begin their long-awaited dialogue on artificial intelligence safety and... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Elecciones regionales en Alemania: un desafío para Friedrich Merz
item.description: Friedrich Merz y el Gobierno alemán enfrentan su mayor desafío en las elecciones regionales. La ultraderecha de AfD logró un triunfo histórico con 44% en Sajonia-Anhalt, mientras la CDU se debilita. ¿Qué está en juego para el futuro político de Alemania? Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.description: Las llamas ya consumieron más de 40 hectáreas de bosque andino y se acercan al pueblo turístico que cada año recibe más de un millón de turistas. "Villa de Leyva no está sola", dijo el presidente Abelardo de la Espriella y prometió ayuda. Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.

item.title: Elecciones regionales en Alemania: dos comicios difíciles para un canciller Merz ya debilitado
item.description: Los alemanes acuden a las urnas este domingo en dos elecciones regionales, en Berlín y Mecklemburgo-Pomerania Occidental, donde los avances de la extrema derecha y la izquierda podrían desestabilizar al gobierno del canciller Friedrich Merz, que se encuentra en su punto más bajo en las encuestas y con tensiones dentro de su propia coalición. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: France’s Macron visits Atlantic territory as EU embraces Canada
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron arrived in the French territory of Saint Pierre and Miquelon for talks with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Sunday, weeks after President Donald Trump posted an image showing the islands ‌covered by the US flag. Macron’s visit to the archipelago off Canada’s Atlantic coast is the first there by a French president since 2014 and comes as Canada seeks closer ties with the European Union amid an increasingly acrimonious trade war with the United States. Saint Pierre... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Reuters

item.title: 'NAZA' documentary about Gaza war sparks political storm in Israel
item.description: The Israeli filmmakers behind the documentary NAZA may have received a standing ovation at the Venice film festival, they have been facing violent threats to their lives and citizenship at home in Israel. A month ahead of crucial elections, the film profiles anonymous military sources who speak about the widespread killing of civilians in Gaza. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he intends to introduce legislation aimed at revoking the citizenship of people who "defame IDF soldiers". Details by Shirli Sitbon, FRANCE 24 international affairs editor. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general
item.description: Former president of Chile drops out after support collapsed in security council straw poll, leaving seven candidates in contest Michelle Bachelet, a former president of Chile, has withdrawn her candidacy to become the next secretary general of the ⁠UN, ending an attempt ​that had struggled to gain traction among security council members. Bachelet, 74, announced ⁠her decision in a video posted on Instagram on Saturday, saying: “I will now continue, with the ⁠same determination as always, my international work.” Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Does Trump’s new AI Force signal tech race escalation ahead of Xi Jinping summit?
item.description: US President Donald Trump has unveiled a new “AI Force” just days ahead of a state visit by Chinese leader Xi Jinping, in a potential escalation of the high-stakes technology race between the rival powers. Experts said the proposed AI Force – whose exact structure remains unclear – could give Beijing a clear counterpart for AI safety talks, but warned it risked becoming an instrument of further technological containment and export controls targeting China. In a social media post on Saturday,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Germany: Could regional polls froce Friedrich Merz to step down?
item.description: Polling is underway in the German capital Berlin and the largely rural state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania for regional elections. Both elections are seen as a test for Germany's centre-right Chancellor Friedrich Merz. He has already scheduled a crisis meeting and decided to skip this week's UN General Assembly to deal with the potential fallout. Could he be forced to step down based on the election’s results? Details and analysis by Yann Wernert, senior policy fellow at the Jacques Delors Centre in Berlin. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Ukraine hits Russia with major drone attack, targetting refinery
item.description: In Russia, voters are on the third and final day of casting ballots in the country's first wartime parliamentary election. Despite the voting however, Ukraine carried out what Moscow described as the "largest ever" drone attack on the Russian capital. Kyiv reportedly fired over 1.000 drones at the country, leaving two dead in the Moscow region and inflicting damage upon an oil refinery. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Kyiv, Gulliver Cragg. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: El centro francés tiene una pregunta: ¿quién puede vencer a Marine Le Pen?
item.description: Uno de los aspirantes a la presidencia se puso un delantal y sirvió patatas fritas desde un food truck. Otro se puso un arnés y subió hasta lo alto de un aerogenerador. Otro más puso en marcha una gira de consulta de «Los mil bistrós». Las artimañas y los efectos espectaculares indican que la campaña para las elecciones presidenciales ya está en marcha. En unas elecciones a dos vueltas que se celebrarán el próximo abril y mayo, los franceses elegirán al sucesor de Emmanuel Macron, quien no puede presentarse a un tercer mandato consecutivo. Las encuestas dan constantemente como favorita a… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Will German's far right party AfD win over two more regions?
item.description: Two weeks after the far-right AfD won its first major regional election in Germany, two more eastern states vote this Sunday. Polls have just opened in the capital, Berlin, and the largely rural state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Berlin, Jörg Taszman. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Bridget Phillipson says Burnham’s past criticisms of US president not an issue as PM prepares to meet Trump at UN Next month’s budget will be made more difficult by Donald Trump’s war with Iran, one of Andy Burnham’s cabinet ministers has said, while adding she did not expect the prime minister’s previous disparaging comments about the US president to be an issue. item.title: Middle powers don’t have to wait for a Trump-Xi-Putin summit
item.description: The prospect of United States, Chinese and Russian leaders meeting at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit in Shenzhen this November has revived the Yalta analogy. Talk of a Trump-Xi-Putin summit – echoing the 1945 meeting that reshaped the world – surfaced during the first Trump term, and speculation returned last year with the 80th anniversary of the second world war. No such meeting occurred. However, Chinese President Xi Jinping hosted the two presidents back-to-back in... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Murder trial of slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi’s former relatives to begin
item.description: Hong Kong prosecutors are set to open the murder trial of three former relatives of slain socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung later this week, three years after her killing shocked the city and drew international attention. The High Court will hold the first trial hearing on Monday for parties to sort out preliminary issues. Jury selection is expected to take place later in the week before the prosecution delivers its opening statement. The 28-year-old influencer’s death came to light in February 2023,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Ukraine pummels Moscow with drones on last day of Russian election
item.description: Ukraine launched ⁠what Moscow’s mayor called the biggest ever drone attack on the Russian capital on Sunday, in what he said was an unsuccessful attempt to disrupt the final day of a parliamentary election that President Vladimir Putin has cast as a test of support for Russia’s war in Ukraine. The drone strikes killed two people in the Moscow region and two more in the Russian-held part of Ukraine’s Kherson region, including an election official, according to Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin and... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: US Congress investigates diversion of sensitive F-35 parts to Hong Kong: report
item.description: The United States Congress has reportedly launched a probe after a shipment of sensitive F-35 fighter jet parts was said to have been unexpectedly diverted to Hong Kong and went missing, with the city’s authorities declining to comment on the case. A spokesman for the Hong Kong government said over the weekend that it would not comment on individual cases, a day after US media outlet Politico reported the story. Según contó la periodista Marcia Frisciotti (Pochi), el mandatario calificó de "tontería mayúscula" politizar el arte y aseguró que, tras la polémica, escuchó temas de la artista que le gustaron. 🎤 "¿Cuál sería el problema de que escuche a Lali? Para mí no sería ningún problema. Me parece una tontería mayúscula politizar el arte. Es más, luego de la polémica escuché algunos temas y me gustaron", respondió el jefe de Estado ante la consulta del programa. 📲 La pregunta surgió después de que Bullrich, jefa del bloque de LLA en el Senado, publicara en X un video con "No me importa", tema de Lali Espósito, horas después de cuestionar los cambios en las prestaciones por discapacidad incluidos en el Presupuesto 2027, al no haber sido informada antes del envío del proyecto al Congreso. ▶️Seguí el minuto a minuto de todas las noticias en nuestro canal de Youtube. #CrónicaTV #Milei #Bullrich #LaLibertadAvanza | Crónica TV

item.title: French outpost off Canada in the spotlight as Macron hosts Carney on symbolic visit
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron embarked Saturday on a symbolic visit to Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a French territory off Canada's Newfoundland, where he hosts Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. The first-ever visit by a Canadian prime minister to the French archipelago in the North Atlantic comes as Carney marks a shift in Ottawa's foreign policy toward Europe amid growing tensions with the US. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Alemania recorta impuestos sobre los combustibles antes de las cruciales elecciones del domingo
item.description: Berlín anunció el viernes medidas para aliviar la subida de los precios del combustible, pocos días después de que el canciller Friedrich Merz se comprometiera a ayudar a los consumidores afectados por el alza de los precios. Estas medidas se anunciaron antes de dos elecciones regionales que suponen un riesgo significativo para el gobierno, debilitado por la reciente victoria del partido de extrema derecha AfD. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
